geometry.population: unique legal identity/tick in this visit selected anchors commit12
geometry.allocation: proportional stage population with one per nonempty stage when feasible
geometry.rounding: ceil population/2; stage floor then largest remaining proportional deficit
geometry.reduction: mean selected unique configurations; no additional stage weights
geometry.rng: explicit independent CPU generator per visit; never model/diffusion RNG
geometry.labels: recorded diagnostic phases for sampling only; never network inputs

offline_planning.scope: offline inference only; unchanged full causal history and optimizer budget

frozen_visual_hotset.scope: Immutable patches/depth/camera timestamps only; no learned features, labels, history or backend inputs

finished.timing_scope: wall_s includes training, resource waits, validation, plots and checkpoints after setup; training_wall_s includes training and its resource waits only; setup_wall_s includes model/cache setup
finished.selection: fixed validation6 all-tick normalized equal Arm/Hand MSE
finished.exposure_budget_rounding: complete causal episode groups; requested correction share enforced at exposure-budget stop, wall-stop actual shares reported
